prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1125; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Appraiser's remarks: The damage to the driver's side is consistent with the side impact described at the intersection, with crush to the front door, rocker panel and rear quarter panel. Repair labor hours are reasonable for the extent of the deformation and the parts listed. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the file or the inspection. Two similar charges posted on the same day are currently under review and will be confirmed with the shop before payment. Recommended plan: replace the front door shell, straighten the rocker, refinish the affected panels and recalibrate the side curtain airbag sensor.
